inputs.command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== HEALTH ==='; curl -sS -D /tmp/mw_health_headers -o /tmp/mw_health_body -w 'HTTP=%{http_code} FINAL_URL=%{url_effective} CT=%{content_type} REDIRECTS=%{num_redirects}\n' https://api.autosklo.org.ua/health/ready; cat /tmp/mw_health_headers; echo '---BODY---'; head -c 2000 /tmp/mw_health_body; echo; echo '=== SESSION ==='; h=android_diag_$(date +%s); curl -sS -D /tmp/mw_session_headers -o /tmp/mw_session_body -w 'HTTP=%{http_code} FINAL_URL=%{url_effective} CT=%{content_type} REDIRECTS=%{num_redirects}\n' -X POST https://api.autosklo.org.ua/api/v1/sessions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' --data-raw "{\"handle\":\"$h\"}"; cat /tmp/mw_session_headers; echo '---BODY---'; head -c 2000 /tmp/mw_session_body; echo; echo '=== LOCAL PROXY ==='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}' | grep -E 'madworld|nginx|caddy|traefik' || true; echo '=== NGINX CONFIG ==='; nginx -T 2>&1 | grep -n -A8 -B4 'api.autosklo.org.ua' | head -120 || true
